pages.text: Penning traps: a solenoid field holds antiparticles radially, an electrostatic well axially. Stable only while ω_c² > 2ω_z². Antihydrogen forms by three-body recombination, ∝ n_e²·T^(−9/2) - cold positrons, dense ones; but a plasma cannot be denser than the Brillouin limit ε₀B²/2m_e.
$(thing)Set$(): Solenoid field, Trap voltage, Positron density, RF melt power.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Positron heating: the plasma runs at T·(1 + 10%·|d|).

$(thing)Limits$(): Penning trap unstable (ω_c² < 2ω_z²); Positron plasma above the Brillouin limit; Interlock: Penning-trap solenoid not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the Penning-trap solenoid quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Production follows the recombination rate.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Cyclotron frequency: ω_c = qB/m$(br)Axial frequency: ω_z = √(qV/(md²))$(br)Trap stability: 1 − 2ω_z²/ω_c²$(br)Positron temperature: T_e$(br)Brillouin limit: n_B = ε₀B²/(2m_e)$(br)Recombination rate: Γ ∝ n_e²·T^(−9/2)$(br)Melt temperature: T_pool
